_comment: Copy to data/personal_setup.json (gitignored) and edit. Every value here is invented.
Apply with ./finance apply-setup; a brand-new database applies it automatically.
categories: added by name, or update the listed fields of an existing category.
kind: income | fixed | variable | tracking | savings | transfer; one_off: true keeps the rows
visible but out of monthly totals (use ./finance tag-event to tag an event's inflows).
rules: pattern + match_type (contains | equals | regex) on the normalized merchant;
optional account_kind (bank | card | gift), direction (in | out), amount_min / amount_max
(bounds on the absolute amount), category, set_transfer, set_excluded, priority.
settings: filled only while unset; ./finance apply-setup --overwrite-settings replaces them.
